production.direction_en: Captain Rusk raises a signal banner over the orchard road. A volley is already aimed at the well.
production.music_direction_en: pre: bgm_tension, snare roll under the signal banner | battle: bgm_boss_human | post: bgm_ledger_motif on 'Seven notches'

commands.speaker: kera_voss
commands.text: Seven notches. Same wax as the seal on your shield. There are letters beneath it: C.V.

commands.speaker: mahmut
commands.text: Do those initials mean anything to you?

commands.speaker: kera_voss
commands.text: Not yet. The Red Vial ledger may know.

commands.speaker: fadyme_thought
commands.text: C.V. I saw those letters on my father’s last page.

commands.speaker: fadyme
commands.text: We should find a healer before we open the order.

commands.speaker: mahmut
commands.text: Then I will carry it, sealed, until we do.
